title: License
lede: Audiobook Studio is open source under a permissive license; engines and models carry their own terms.
body:
At a glance
  • MIT-licensed project code.
  • Third-party and engine licenses apply separately.

Project license

The project code is MIT-licensed.

Third-party & engines

Engines, models, and voices carry their own licenses. When you install an engine or import a voice, its license applies — Studio surfaces those terms but doesn't override them.
